breakdown.description: Preamble states two incompatible interpretations of Nx and dx (interval-based vs point-based).
breakdown.reason: The generated specification does not repeat the erroneous 'Nx as number of grid points including both endpoints' or 'dx=(b-a)/(Nx-1)' instruction. It correctly states 'uniform periodic grid with Nx=512 points' on the half-open domain [0,1), which aligns with the ground truth's periodic grid convention (dx=1/Nx, no duplicated endpoint).
